from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    strong_wind = rng.random() < 0.55
    route_open = rng.random() < 0.7
    pouch_ready = rng.random() < 0.65
    pip_control = 2 if rng.random() < 0.55 else 1
    invitation_count = 3 if rng.random() < 0.5 else 4
    delicate = "herb_roof" if rng.random() < 0.5 else "glasshouse"
    wind = 2 if strong_wind else 1

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "pip": {"name": "Pip", "kind": "dragon"},
        "mara": {"name": "Mara", "kind": "keeper"},
        "roof_post": {"name": "roof post", "kind": "place"},
        "herb_roof": {"name": "herb roof", "kind": "place"},
        "glasshouse": {"name": "glasshouse roof", "kind": "place"},
        "chimney_nook": {"name": "chimney nook", "kind": "place"},
        "invitations": {"name": "invitations", "kind": "prop"},
        "pouch": {"name": "cloth pouch", "kind": "prop"},
        "basket": {"name": "light basket", "kind": "prop"},
        "twine": {"name": "twine", "kind": "prop"},
        "ribbon": {"name": "ribbon marker", "kind": "prop"},
        "pots": {"name": "labeled pots", "kind": "group"},
    }

    initial = {
        "ada.location": "roof_post",
        "pip.location": "roof_post",
        "mara.location": "roof_post",

        "invitations.location": "roof_post",
        "invitations.count": invitation_count,
        "invitations.delivered": 0,
        "invitations.secured": False,
        "invitations.dry": True,
        "invitations.torn": False,

        "pouch.location": "roof_post",
        "pouch.owner": "mara",
        "pouch.condition": "ready" if pouch_ready else "repair",
        "pouch.tied": False,

        "basket.location": "roof_post",
        "basket.owner": "mara",
        "basket.covered": False,
        "basket.loaded": False,

        "twine.location": "roof_post",
        "twine.owner": "mara",
        "twine.tied": False,

        "ribbon.location": "roof_post",
        "ribbon.wind": wind,

        "roof_post.route": "open",
        "herb_roof.route": "open",
        "glasshouse.route": "open" if route_open else "closed",
        "chimney_nook.route": "open",

        "pots.filled": False,
        "pots.section": delicate,

        "pip.breath_control": pip_control,
        "pip.breath_tested": False,
        "pip.memes.Ambition": 1,
        "pip.memes.Care": 1,
        "pip.memes.Curiosity": 1,

        "ada.memes.Ambition": 2,
        "ada.memes.Care": 1,
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": 1,

        "mara.memes.Care": 2,

        "ada.knows.ribbon.wind": None,
        "ada.knows.invitations.torn": None,
        "ada.knows.glasshouse.route": None,

        "mara.knows.ribbon.wind": None,
        "mara.knows.invitations.torn": None,
        "mara.knows.glasshouse.route": None,

        "mara.trusts.ada": False,

        "delivery.method": "none",
        "delivery.complete": False,
        "arrangement.final": False,
    }

    scenes = [
        Scene(
            "notice_flutter",
            "observation",
            ("ada", "invitations", "roof_post"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("invitations.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
            ),
            (E("ada.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc"),),
            "Ada noticed the invitations fluttering at the roof post",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_wind",
            "ada",
            "ribbon.wind",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the ribbon wind-marker",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_paper",
            "ada",
            "invitations.torn",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("invitations.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the invitation papers",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_route",
            "ada",
            "glasshouse.route",
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "roof_post"),),
            summary="Ada inspected the glasshouse route",
        ),
        Scene(
            "test_pip_puff",
            "observation",
            ("pip", "invitations", "roof_post"),
            (
                C("pip.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("pip.breath_tested", "eq", False),
                C("invitations.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
            ),
            (
                E("pip.breath_tested", True),
                E("pip.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc"),
            ),
            "Pip tested a tiny puff beside a loose invitation",
        ),
        tell(
            "explain_wind",
            "ada",
            "mara",
            "ribbon.wind",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.ribbon.wind", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Mara what the wind-marker showed",
        ),
        tell(
            "explain_paper",
            "ada",
            "mara",
            "invitations.torn",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.invitations.torn", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Mara whether the invitations were intact",
        ),
        tell(
            "explain_route",
            "ada",
            "mara",
            "glasshouse.route",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.glasshouse.route", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Mara whether the glasshouse route was open",
        ),
        Scene(
            "repair_pouch",
            "care",
            ("mara", "pouch", "twine"),
            (
                C("mara.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("pouch.owner", "eq", "mara"),
                C("pouch.condition", "eq", "repair"),
            ),
            (
                E("pouch.condition", "ready"),
                E("pouch.tied", True),
                E("mara.trusts.ada", True),
            ),
            "Mara repaired and tied the cloth pouch",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_pouch",
            "mara",
            "ada",
            "pouch",
            requires=(
                C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("pouch.owner", "eq", "mara"),
                C("pouch.condition", "eq", "ready"),
                C("mara.trusts.ada", "eq", True),
            ),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the ready cloth pouch",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_basket",
            "mara",
            "ada",
            "basket",
            requires=(
                C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("basket.owner", "eq", "mara"),
            ),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the light basket",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_twine",
            "mara",
            "ada",
            "twine",
            requires=(
                C("mara.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("twine.owner", "eq", "mara"),
            ),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the twine",
        ),
        Scene(
            "tie_pouch",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "pip", "pouch", "invitations"),
            (
                C("pouch.owner", "eq", "ada"),
                C("pouch.condition", "eq", "ready"),
                C("invitations.torn", "eq", False),
                C("invitations.secured", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("pouch.tied", True),
                E("invitations.secured", True),
                E("delivery.method", "pouch"),
            ),
            "Ada and Pip tied the invitations securely inside the pouch",
        ),
        Scene(
            "load_basket",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "pip", "basket", "invitations"),
            (
                C("basket.owner", "eq", "ada"),
                C("invitations.torn", "eq", False),
                C("invitations.secured", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("basket.loaded", True),
                E("basket.covered", True),
                E("invitations.secured", True),
                E("delivery.method", "basket"),
            ),
            "Ada covered the loaded invitations in the light basket",
        ),
        Scene(
            "tie_line",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "mara", "twine", "roof_post"),
            (
                C("twine.owner", "eq", "ada"),
                C("mara.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("invitations.torn", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("twine.tied", True),
                E("delivery.method", "twine"),
                E("mara.trusts.ada", True),
            ),
            "Ada and Mara tied a guiding twine line between safe posts",
        ),
        Scene(
            "walk_delivery",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "mara", "invitations", "pots"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("mara.location", "eq", "roof_post"),
                C("invitations.secured", "eq", False),
                C("invitations.torn", "eq", False),
                C("glasshouse.route", "eq", "open"),
                C("invitations.delivered", "lt", invitation_count),
            ),
            (
                E("invitations.delivered", invitation_count),
                E("invitations.location", "glasshouse"),
                E("pots.filled", True),
                E("arrangement.final", True),
                E("delivery.complete", True),
            ),
            "Ada and Mara carried the invitations along the open route to the labeled pots",
        ),
        Scene(
            "guide_pouch",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "pip", "pouch", "twine"),
            (
                C("delivery.method", "in", ("pouch", "twine")),
                C("invitations.secured", "eq", True),
                C("twine.tied", "eq", True),
                C("pip.breath_tested", "eq", True),
                C("pip.breath_control", "ge", 2),
                C("invitations.delivered", "lt", invitation_count),
            ),
            (
                E("invitations.delivered", invitation_count),
                E("pouch.location", "glasshouse"),
                E("invitations.location", "glasshouse"),
                E("pots.filled", True),
                E("arrangement.final", True),
                E("delivery.complete", True),
            ),
            "Pip used a measured warm puff while Ada guided the secured pouch",
        ),
        Scene(
            "guide_basket",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "pip", "basket", "invitations"),
            (
                C("delivery.method", "eq", "basket"),
                C("basket.loaded", "eq", True),
                C("basket.covered", "eq", True),
                C("invitations.secured", "eq", True),
                C("pip.breath_tested", "eq", True),
                C("pip.breath_control", "ge", 2),
                C("invitations.delivered", "lt", invitation_count),
            ),
            (
                E("invitations.delivered", invitation_count),
                E("basket.location", "chimney_nook"),
                E("invitations.location", "chimney_nook"),
                E("pots.filled", True),
                E("arrangement.final", True),
                E("delivery.complete", True),
            ),
            "Pip nudged the covered basket in short controlled bursts to the chimney nook",
        ),
        Scene(
            "finish_by_hand",
            "ambition",
            ("ada", "mara", "invitations", "pots"),
            (
                C("invitations.delivered", "lt", invitation_count),
                C("invitations.torn", "eq", False),
                C("glasshouse.route", "eq", "open"),
                C("arrangement.final", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("invitations.delivered", invitation_count),
                E("invitations.location", "glasshouse"),
                E("pots.filled", True),
                E("arrangement.final", True),
                E("delivery.complete", True),
            ),
            "Ada and Mara placed the remaining intact invitations beneath labeled pots",
        ),
    ]

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "no_torn_delivery",
            (C("invitations.delivered", "eq", 0),),
            (C("invitations.torn", "eq", True),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "delivery_limit",
            (C("invitations.delivered", "le", invitation_count),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "secured_puff",
            (C("invitations.secured", "eq", True),),
            (C("pip.breath_tested", "eq", True),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "single_pouch_owner",
            (C("pouch.owner", "in", ("ada", "mara")),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "single_basket_owner",
            (C("basket.owner", "in", ("ada", "mara")),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "single_twine_owner",
            (C("twine.owner", "in", ("ada", "mara")),),
        ),
    )

    goal = (
        C("invitations.delivered", "eq", invitation_count),
        C("pots.filled", "eq", True),
        C("arrangement.final", "eq", True),
    )

    labels = {
        "invitations.delivered": "invitations delivered",
        "invitations.count": "total invitations",
        "ribbon.wind": "wind strength",
        "glasshouse.route": "glasshouse route",
        "delivery.method": "delivery method",
        "arrangement.final": "final arrangement",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "Invitations Above the Roofs",
        entities,
        initial,
        tuple(scenes),
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
